name: TryBooking
shortDescription: A UK event-ticketing and registration platform with a church-specific workflow, free-event registration, mobile ticket scanning and published data-processing documentation.
suitableContexts: Churches running free registration events, carol services or suppers
Paid church events needing online tickets and mobile scanning
Organisations that require a published UK data-processing addendum

pricing.summary: TryBooking publishes no charge for free events. For paid events, it publishes a 5% processing fee plus 15p per ticket when payments are processed by TryBooking, or a 75p ticket fee plus Stripe fees for payments to an organiser’s Stripe account. The supplier says organisers can choose whether to absorb or pass on its fees.

tiers.label: Free events
tiers.detail: Supplier says all features are available for free events without hidden charges.

tiers.label: TryBooking payments
tiers.detail: Published fee route when payments are processed by TryBooking.

tiers.label: Stripe-connected payments
tiers.detail: Published TryBooking ticket fee for payments paid directly to the organiser’s Stripe account.

gdprInformation: TryBooking UK publishes a privacy policy, current event-organiser terms, sub-processor list and data-processing addendum. Its sub-processor page states that it uses AWS infrastructure located in London. The DPA describes processing on behalf of event organisers and includes material on restricted transfers. A church should still select only necessary attendee fields, review the live terms and configure its own event notices, retention and access controls.
coreFeatures: UK-based support by phone, email and live chat
importExport: Privacy policy refers to a Request Data tool for data provided during bookings
Confirm organiser attendee export formats, deletion workflow and data-retention configuration before use
support: Supplier describes UK-based support via phone, email and live chat
Confirm coverage and incident escalation for a critical event before purchase

data-processing.value: TryBooking publishes a UK GDPR data-processing addendum and a sub-processor page that names AWS infrastructure in London.

uk-operator.value: TryBooking’s current website terms and event-organiser terms identify TryBooking UK Ltd, number 08559255, as the operator of the UK service.

church-workflow.value: Supplier publishes a church event-ticketing page covering free community events, carol services, church suppers and mobile ticket scanning.

published-pricing.value: Supplier publishes free-event access and its paid-event fees for TryBooking and Stripe-connected payment routes.

editorial.assessment: TryBooking is an event-registration and ticketing service, not a church-management, Gift Aid or safeguarding system. It is particularly relevant for UK churches because its official material addresses church events directly and its public legal and data-processing material is more detailed than many generic alternatives. Churches should still minimise the data they collect and keep event registration separate from sensitive pastoral or safeguarding records.
bestFor: Free church events requiring online registration
Paid events needing ticket scanning and either supplier or Stripe payment processing
Churches that want public DPA and sub-processor documentation before use

Confirm current attendee-data export, deletion, refunds and event-day support terms before use
